EchoLingo 0.3.1：Windows 和 Linux 版正式发布，有 NVIDIA 显卡的电脑可以下载 GPU 加速包。Mac 上的 0.3.0 可以直接在应用内更新到这一版。
EchoLingo 0.3.1 is the first release for Windows and Linux, with an optional GPU acceleration pack for NVIDIA graphics cards. On the Mac, 0.3.0 updates to it from inside the app.

[中文](#中文) · [English](#english)

## 中文

### 更新内容

- **Windows 和 Linux 版**：第一次公开发布 Windows（x64 安装程序）和 Linux（x64 .deb 包）版，功能与 Mac 版相同。识别和翻译默认在 CPU 上运行；有 NVIDIA 显卡的电脑可以在 **Settings → Models → GPU acceleration** 下载 GPU 加速包。在一台 i7-13700H 笔记本上，只用 CPU 时识别跟不上实时速度；用加速包（RTX 4060 Laptop）时，实时识别的延迟中位数为 0.1–0.2 秒、最长约 2 秒，翻译每秒约 135 个 token。
- **在真实 Windows 电脑上发现并修复的问题**：
  - 后台的识别和翻译进程不再被 Windows 的电源节流拖慢。在我们的测试中，识别完成延迟从 5.8 秒降到 2.1 秒，翻译速度从每秒 59 个 token 提高到 145 个。
  - 采集系统声音时，电脑没有播放任何声音也不会再冒出 “The.” 这样的空句子。
  - 模型下载卡住时会自动重试，不会一直停在那里。

**0.3.0 的更新（第一次使用 Windows 或 Linux 版时也会用到）**：应用内更新；下课后的自动标题恢复正常；填写课程背景后，没人说话时不会再冒出背景文字；AI 笔记的 Contents 目录移到笔记右侧。

### 安装

**macOS（Apple Silicon）**

1. 已安装 0.3.0：在 **Settings → General → Updates** 检查更新（启动时也会自动检查），一键下载、校验并重启。
2. 新安装或从 0.2.0 升级：下载 `EchoLingo_0.3.1_aarch64.dmg`，把 EchoLingo 拖进“应用程序”，替换旧版本即可，历史记录、设置和模型都会保留。本版**未经 Apple 公证**，首次打开需要手动放行：
   - macOS 14：在“应用程序”中按住 Control 点按 EchoLingo →“打开”→“打开”。
   - macOS 15 及以上：先双击一次并点“完成”，再到“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性”底部点“仍要打开”。
   - 仍无法打开时，在终端运行 `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/EchoLingo.app`。
   - 更新后，macOS 可能会要求重新授予麦克风和“屏幕与系统录音”权限。

**Windows 10 / 11（x64）**

1. 下载并运行 `EchoLingo_0.3.1_x64-setup.exe`。只为当前用户安装，不需要管理员权限；缺少 Microsoft Edge WebView2 运行时时会自动安装。
2. 安装程序**没有代码签名**，SmartScreen 可能提示“Windows 已保护你的电脑”：点“更多信息”→“仍要运行”。
3. 完成首次设置向导后，到 **Settings → Models** 下载本地模型；有 NVIDIA 显卡时，在同一页的 **GPU acceleration** 下载 GPU 加速包。

**Linux（Ubuntu 22.04+ / Debian 12+，x64）**

1. 下载 `EchoLingo_0.3.1_amd64.deb`，在下载目录运行 `sudo apt install ./EchoLingo_0.3.1_amd64.deb`。
2. 从应用菜单打开 EchoLingo（或在终端运行 `echolingo-desktop`），完成首次设置向导后，到 **Settings → Models** 下载本地模型和可选的 GPU 加速包。用显卡翻译还需要 `sudo apt install libvulkan1`。

本页的 `echolingo-gpu-pack-*` 文件就是 GPU 加速包，应用会自己下载，不需要手动下载。第一次使用需要下载约 4.5 GB 的本地模型；中国大陆网络可以试试 Hugging Face 镜像，设置方法见 README。

详细用法见 [README](https://github.com/Asphr726/EchoLingo#readme)。

### 系统要求

- **macOS**：macOS 14 及以上 · Apple Silicon（M1 或更新）· 建议 16 GB 内存 · 约 6 GB 可用磁盘空间。
- **Windows**：Windows 10 21H2 及以上或 Windows 11（x64）· 支持 AVX2 的处理器 · 建议 16 GB 内存 · 约 6 GB 可用磁盘空间。
- **Linux**：Ubuntu 22.04 / Debian 12 及以上（x64）· 支持 AVX2 的处理器 · 建议 16 GB 内存 · 约 6 GB 可用磁盘空间。
- **GPU 加速包（可选，Windows 和 Linux）**：NVIDIA 显卡，计算能力 7.5 及以上（GeForce GTX 16 系列、RTX 20 系列或更新）· 驱动 580.65 或更新 · Windows 上下载约 2.0 GB、解压后约 3.6 GB，Linux 上约 2.6 GB / 5.4 GB，安装时两者同时占用空间。

### 已知限制

- 未签名、未公证：Mac 首次打开需要手动放行，Windows 会弹出 SmartScreen 提示（见上）。
- Linux 版只在自动构建环境中测试过，还没有在真实电脑上测试；Linux 暂不支持采集系统声音。
- Linux 上不能在应用内安装更新：有新版本时应用会提示，并给出发布页面的链接。
- GPU 加速包与应用版本一一对应，每次更新应用后都要在 **Settings → Models** 重新下载；GPU 加速暂只支持 NVIDIA 显卡。
- 不支持 Intel Mac。
- 应用界面目前只有英文。

## English

### What's new

- **Windows and Linux**: the first public Windows (x64 installer) and Linux (x64 .deb package) releases, with the same features as the Mac version. Recognition and translation run on the CPU by default; on a computer with an NVIDIA graphics card, download the GPU acceleration pack in **Settings → Models → GPU acceleration**. On an i7-13700H laptop, recognition on the CPU alone could not keep up in real time; with the pack (RTX 4060 Laptop), live recognition lagged 0.1–0.2 s at the median and about 2 s at most, and translation ran at about 135 tokens per second.
- **Fixes found on real Windows hardware**:
  - Background recognition and translation processes are no longer slowed down by Windows power throttling. In our test, recognition finish latency fell from 5.8 s to 2.1 s and translation rose from 59 to 145 tokens per second.
  - Capturing system audio while nothing is playing no longer produces phantom lines such as "The.".
  - A model download that stalls is retried automatically instead of hanging.

**Also in 0.3.0 (new to you if this is your first Windows or Linux version)**: in-app updates; automatic session titles work again; the lecture context no longer shows up as text while nobody is speaking; the AI notes Contents list sits to the right of the notes.

### Install

**macOS (Apple Silicon)**

1. With 0.3.0 installed: check for updates in **Settings → General → Updates** (EchoLingo also checks at launch), then download, verify and restart in one step.
2. New installs, or coming from 0.2.0: download `EchoLingo_0.3.1_aarch64.dmg` and drag EchoLingo into Applications, replacing the old app; your history, settings and models are kept. This build is **not notarized by Apple**, so the first launch needs one manual step:
   - macOS 14: Control-click EchoLingo in Applications → Open → Open.
   - macOS 15 and later: double-click once and choose Done, then click **Open Anyway** at the bottom of System Settings → Privacy & Security.
   - If it still refuses to open, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/EchoLingo.app` in Terminal.
   - After an update, macOS may ask again for the microphone and Screen & System Audio Recording permissions.

**Windows 10 / 11 (x64)**

1. Download and run `EchoLingo_0.3.1_x64-setup.exe`. It installs for your user account only and needs no administrator rights; if the Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime is missing, it is installed too.
2. The installer is **not code-signed**, so SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": click **More info** → **Run anyway**.
3. After the setup assistant, download the local models in **Settings → Models**; with an NVIDIA graphics card, download the GPU acceleration pack under **GPU acceleration** on the same page.

**Linux (Ubuntu 22.04+ / Debian 12+, x64)**

1. Download `EchoLingo_0.3.1_amd64.deb` and, in the folder you downloaded it to, run `sudo apt install ./EchoLingo_0.3.1_amd64.deb`.
2. Open EchoLingo from the application menu (or run `echolingo-desktop`) and, after the setup assistant, download the local models and the optional GPU acceleration pack in **Settings → Models**. GPU translation also needs `sudo apt install libvulkan1`.

The `echolingo-gpu-pack-*` files on this page are the GPU acceleration packs; the app downloads them by itself, so there is no need to download them by hand. The first use needs about 4.5 GB of local models to be downloaded.

See the [README](https://github.com/Asphr726/EchoLingo/blob/main/README.en.md) for the full guide.

### Requirements

- **macOS**: macOS 14 or later · Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) · 16 GB of memory recommended · about 6 GB of free disk space.
- **Windows**: Windows 10 21H2 or later, or Windows 11 (x64) · a processor with AVX2 · 16 GB of memory recommended · about 6 GB of free disk space.
- **Linux**: Ubuntu 22.04 / Debian 12 or later (x64) · a processor with AVX2 · 16 GB of memory recommended · about 6 GB of free disk space.
- **GPU acceleration pack (optional, Windows and Linux)**: an NVIDIA graphics card with compute capability 7.5 or higher (GeForce GTX 16-series, RTX 20-series or newer) · driver 580.65 or later · on Windows about 2.0 GB to download and 3.6 GB unpacked, on Linux about 2.6 GB and 5.4 GB; both take space while it installs.

### Known limitations

- Unsigned and not notarized: the first launch on the Mac needs a manual step, and Windows shows a SmartScreen warning (see above).
- The Linux version has only been tested on automated build machines, not on a real computer yet; Linux cannot capture system audio yet.
- On Linux, updates are not installed from inside the app: EchoLingo tells you when a new version is out and links to its release page.
- Each GPU acceleration pack matches one app version, so download it again in **Settings → Models** after every update; GPU acceleration supports NVIDIA cards only.
- Intel Macs are not supported.
- The interface is English only for now.
